question: Which of the following is called as 'the temple of the country's democracy'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Parliament.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **According to former President Ram Nath Kovind**, Parliament is the **highest platform for debating matters **of public importance and the** temple of democracy.**
 
• The former **President **made the comments during his speech to the nation on the eve of the **country's 75th Independence Day.**
